data.name: Steel Spells
data.description: A forgemaster adds the following spells to her spell list: 1st-crafter's curse, crafter's fortune, lead blades; 2nd-chill metal, heat metal, shatter; 3rd-keen edge, versatile weapon; 8th-iron body, repel metal or stone.
